  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
description: Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from user temp directories, commonly abused by post-exploitation tools.

rule Suspicious_PowerShell_From_Email_Client {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell launched with hidden window and encoded command from email client"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1566.001"
        date = "2026-04-12"
    strings:
        $encoded = "-encodedcommand" nocase
        $hidden = "-w hidden" nocase
        $nop = "-nop" nocase
        $parent_outlook = "outlook.exe" nocase
    condition:
        $encoded and $hidden and $nop and process.parent.name matches /outlook\.exe/i
}
